metadata.question: Was the area covered by solar panels in the Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan greater than 7,000 hectares in January 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED), Jan 1–31, 2022, over a rectangle covering Bhadla Solar Park vicinity (Rajasthan): [lon 71.6–72.6, lat 27.1–27.8].
- Fallbacks: widen date (2021-12-15 to 2022-02-15), then Sentinel-2 L1C, then Landsat 8/9 L2.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds/shadows: S2 uses SCL (exclude 3,8,9,10,11); L1C uses QA60 bits; Landsat uses QA_PIXEL bitmask.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size==0 after fallbacks => C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking==0 => C2.
- If computed area is null/NaN/invalid => C3.
- Else compare PV area against 7000 ha; ">7000 ha" => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([71.6, 27.1, 72.6, 27.8], null, false);
    const primaryStart = '2022-01-01';
    const primaryEnd = '2022-01-31';
    const fallbackStart = '2021-12-15';
    const fallbackEnd = '2022-02-15';
    const areaThresholdHa = 7000;

    // 2. Helper functions
    function maskS2SR(img) {
      // Mask clouds & shadows using SCL
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const mask = scl.neq(3) // cloud shadow
        .and(scl.neq(8)) // cloud medium
        .and(scl.neq(9)) // cloud high
        .and(scl.neq(10)) // cirrus
        .and(scl.neq(11)); // snow
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function scaleS2(img) {
      const bands = ['B2','B3','B4','B8','B11','B12'];
      return img.select(bands).multiply(0.0001).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    function getS2SRComposite(start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end)
        .map(maskS2SR).map(scaleS2);
      return col.median().set('collection_size', col.size());
    }
    function maskS2L1C(img) {
      // QA60 bits 10 (cirrus) and 11 (cloud) - mask if set
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBitMask = ee.Number(2).pow(10).int();
      const cirrusBitMask = ee.Number(2).pow(11).int();
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function scaleS2L1C(img) {
      const bands = ['B2','B3','B4','B8','B11','B12'];
      return img.select(bands).multiply(0.0001).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    function getS2L1CComposite(start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end)
        .map(maskS2L1C).map(scaleS2L1C);
      return col.median().set('collection_size', col.size());
    }
    function getLandsatComposite(start, end) {
      // Landsat 8/9 L2 combined
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      const col = l8.merge(l9).map(function(img) {
        // Scale factors
        const optical = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
        // QA_PIXEL cloud & shadow mask
        const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
        const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
        const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
        const mask = cloud.not().and(cloudShadow.not());
        return optical.updateMask(mask).rename(['B2','B3','B4','B8','B11','B12']).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
      });
      return col.median().set('collection_size', col.size());
    }

    // 3. Acquire data with fallbacks
    let colPrimary = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(primaryStart, primaryEnd);
    const primaryCount = colPrimary.size().getInfo();
    let meanCloud = null;
    if (primaryCount > 0) {
      meanCloud = colPrimary.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo();
    }
    let composite = null;
    let srcTag = null;
    if (primaryCount === 0) {
      // Widen date
      colPrimary = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd);
      const widenedCount = colPrimary.size().getInfo();
      if (widenedCount === 0) {
        // Try L1C widened
        const l1cCount = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED')
          .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd).size().getInfo();
        if (l1cCount === 0) {
          // Try Landsat
          const lsCount = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd).size()
            .add(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd).size()).getInfo();
          if (lsCount === 0) {
            console.log(`S2/S2-L1C/Landsat Images: 0`);
            console.log('C1');
            return;
          } else {
            composite = getLandsatComposite(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd);
            srcTag = 'Landsat L2 (widened)';
          }
        } else {
          composite = getS2L1CComposite(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd);
          srcTag = 'S2 L1C (widened)';
        }
      } else {
        composite = getS2SRComposite(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd);
        srcTag = 'S2 SR (widened)';
        meanCloud = colPrimary.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo();
      }
    } else {
      composite = getS2SRComposite(primaryStart, primaryEnd);
      srcTag = 'S2 SR (Jan 2022)';
    }

    const comp = ee.Image(composite);
    const compCount = comp.get('collection_size').getInfo();

    // 4. Validate valid pixels after masking
    const validCountObj = comp.select(0).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();
    const validCount = validCountObj ? Object.values(validCountObj)[0] : 0;
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`${srcTag} Images: ${compCount}`);
      console.log('Valid 1km samples: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Solar panel detection (dark, low-NIR/SWIR, low NDVI, not water)
    const B2 = comp.select('B2');
    const B3 = comp.select('B3');
    const B4 = comp.select('B4');
    const B8 = comp.select('B8');
    const B11 = comp.select('B11');
    const B12 = comp.select('B12');

    const ndvi = B8.subtract(B4).divide(B8.add(B4).add(1e-6));
    const ndwi = B3.subtract(B8).divide(B3.add(B8).add(1e-6));
    const visMax = B2.max(B3).max(B4);

    const lowNIR = B8.lt(0.12);
    const lowSWIR = B11.lt(0.12).and(B12.lt(0.12));
    const lowNDVI = ndvi.lt(0.1);
    const notWater = ndwi.lt(0.0);
    const darkVis = visMax.lt(0.20);
    const nirRedRatioLt1 = B8.divide(B4.add(1e-6)).lt(1.0);

    let pvMask = lowNIR.and(lowSWIR).and(lowNDVI).and(notWater).and(darkVis).and(nirRedRatioLt1);

    // Morphological cleanup at ~10-30 m scale
    pvMask = pvMask.focal_min({radius: 15, units: 'meters'}).focal_max({radius: 30, units: 'meters'});

    // 6. Area calculation using aggregated pixelArea (to allow scale=1000 reduceRegion)
    const area10 = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(pvMask).rename('area');
    const areaAgg = area10.reduceResolution({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      maxPixels: 65535
    }).reproject({crs: 'EPSG:4326', scale: 1000});
    const areaDict = areaAgg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();

    const areaM2 = areaDict ? areaDict['area'] : null;
    if (areaM2 === null || typeof areaM2 === 'undefined' || !isFinite(areaM2)) {
      console.log(`${srcTag} Images: ${compCount}, Mean cloud %: ${meanCloud !== null ? meanCloud.toFixed(1) : 'n/a'}`);
      console.log('Calculation failed (area is null/invalid).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const areaHa = areaM2 / 10000.0;

    // 7. Output concise evidence and final answer
    const geomAreaKm2 = ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 3000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getNumber('area').getInfo() / 1e6;

    console.log(`Geometry area (km²): ${geomAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`${srcTag} Images: ${compCount}, Mean cloud %: ${meanCloud !== null ? meanCloud.toFixed(1) : 'n/a'}`);
    console.log(`Valid 1km samples: ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`PV area (hectares): ${areaHa.toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`Threshold (ha): ${areaThresholdHa}`);

    const answer = areaHa > areaThresholdHa ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error:', err.toString().slice(0, 200));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
